quotes.text:
# This file is used by all AArch64 Win64 builds

ac_add_options --target=aarch64-pc-windows-msvc

. $topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.clang-cl

if test -n "$USE_ARTIFACT"; then
ac_add_options --disable-mapi
fi

# This file is sourced by the nightly and release mozconfigs.

. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/common"

ac_add_options --enable-update-channel=${MOZ_UPDATE_CHANNEL}

# Needed to enable breakpad in application.ini
export MOZILLA_OFFICIAL=1

# Package js shell.
export MOZ_PACKAGE_JSSHELL=1

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 666 adds six Win64 Arm64 mozconfig files. common-win64 sets the aarch64-pc-windows-msvc target and sources clang-cl; common-opt sets update channel, official-build metadata and JavaScript shell packaging. nightly and release select distinct branding, debug enables debug, and l10n-mozconfig composes the localization common file. Current files keep that division, and USE_ARTIFACT disables MAPI in common-win64. The historical Linux UPX chmod workaround is no longer there. These are static configurations, not verified build modes.
title: Separate common platform mozconfig from build-mode mozconfig
